title: Pool Worker Execution Context
description: Launcher-owned per-attempt execution marker. Version 2 binds the workspace and makes the freshness expectation an explicit launcher-owned field instead of a preflight-hardcoded window. The supervisor is the only permitted issuer; the worker treats every field as untrusted until preflight validates it against this schema and against launcher-supplied expectations.

attempt_nonce.description: Single-use launcher-generated value. Reuse identifies a replayed launch context.

expires_at.description: Launcher-owned absolute expiry. Preflight rejects the attempt at or after this instant regardless of max_age_seconds.

max_age_seconds.description: Launcher-owned freshness budget. The orchestrator specification fixes a five-minute ceiling; a launcher may be stricter and never laxer.

workspace_path.description: Absolute path of the ephemeral per-attempt workspace this context is bound to.
